title: Year 8 visual world, take two
question: Steered for fun and playful. The roll assigned Tour Tee. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Tour Tee
options.lineage: screenprinted band merch and the back-print tour list
options.thesis: The term is the tour, and every lesson is a date on the back of the shirt.
options.viewport: A black print field with the unit name set as a tour logo, and under it the whole term running as a back-print tour list, one lesson per line, assessment lessons flagged like sold-out shows.
options.risk: Bootleg merch lettering goes illegible fast and heavy distress can look cheap. Only the display voice is screenprinted; body copy stays clean and the reading surface stays light for the projector.

options.label: Foundation Course
options.thesis: Every lesson is a compositional exercise in primary shapes you can pick up and rearrange.
options.viewport: A white worktable ruled by a visible grid, the term's sections laid out as primary shapes you drag into balance.
options.risk: Primary shapes read young. This is the card most likely to feel like Year 3 rather than Year 8.
options.case: The strongest challenger and genuinely playful, with the drag-to-arrange interaction earning its keep. It loses on identification: the kids do not hold the reference, and the primaries read younger than the room.

options.label: Sampler Cloth
options.thesis: The term stitched as bands of increasing difficulty, the last band looser and more confident than the first.
options.viewport: Bands stacked down the cloth, alphabets first and a full scene last, the learner's signature ruled in at the foot.
options.risk: Soft where the brief asks for loud, and it reads as craft rather than music.
options.case: A lovely mapping: bands of increasing difficulty are honestly what a term of skill-building is. It fuses poorly against the steer, because silk on linen cannot be the loud, playful thing you just asked for.

options.label: Deep Dive
options.lineage: a technical dive down a volcanic island wall
options.thesis: The term as a descent, each lesson pinned to its own depth on one vertical axis.
options.viewport: A single vertical axis descending from turquoise surface to dark wall, lessons hanging off it at increasing depth.
options.risk: Depth implies later equals deeper equals harder, which is a position claim this site is not allowed to make. Dark ground fights the projector too.
options.case: The vertical axis is a real sequence device and the world is atmospheric. It fuses poorly on product truth: it smuggles a progression the site has explicitly refused.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What a school course site ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A tidy grid of week cards over a neutral ground, a sidebar listing the lessons, breadcrumbs above the title.
canonCard.risk: Safe and instantly legible, and indistinguishable from the Canvas pages this is meant to replace.
